title: pvADIOS2CoreImageReader
body:
## pvADIOS2CoreImageReader

Reads variables from an ADIOS2 BP file or BP4/BP5 directory as arrays on a uniform image (vtkImageData). One variable (Image Dimension) defines the image size; each selected variable becomes a point or cell array according to its shape, and an optional variable supplies the time values. Use it for simulation codes that write plain multi-dimensional arrays through ADIOS2; use pvADIOS2VTXReader when the file embeds a VTK schema and pvFidesReader when it follows a Fides data model.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Arrays whose shape matches neither the point nor the cell dimensions of the chosen dimension variable cannot be placed on the image; pick the dimension variable that matches the fields you need.
- Schemaxis generates this reader binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check with a sample file of this format.

Native constructor: `ADIOS2CoreImageReader`. Identity: `sources/ADIOS2CoreImageReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Arrays` | This property lists all adios2 arrays that can be read. Based on the dimension info, arrays will be parsed as point or cell data. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the ADIOS2 filename. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ImageDimension` | Use the dimension info of the array to populate image dimension. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Timesteparray` | Use the array to populate time steps info. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Usedimensionarrayascelldata` | The dimension of image data is 1 larger than its cell data's dimension. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvADIOS2CoreImageReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
